name: FFS_MSG_AGENT_CREDENTIAL
description: Stores credentials to be used to send messages with a particular delivery channel.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: The user credentials to be used for authorization. Optional. If the 'user' parameter is not specified, server uses the APP_InternalUserName and APP_InternalUserPass values from app_server.cfg. Encrypted.

columns.name: PASSWORD
columns.description: The user credentials to be used for authorization. Optional. If the 'user' parameter is not specified, server uses the APP_InternalUserName and APP_InternalUserPass values from app_server.cfg. Encrypted .

columns.name: HASH
columns.description: It is a hashed credentials data. Encrypted .

columns.name: CA_FILE
columns.description: It is a x509 trust file. Encrypted .

columns.name: CERT_FILE
columns.description: It is a file with client certificates to be sent to server. (default - use anonymous authorization). Encrypted .

columns.name: CRL_FILE
columns.description: It is a x509 crl file. Encrypted .

columns.name: KEY_FILE
columns.description: It is a file with a client private key. (default - use anonymous authorization). Encrypted .

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
